findings.detail: Re-screened 19 sealed labels with deeper pagination (tx≤30, internal≤12) and nested dust tiers from legacy 1e12 down to single-wei. Aggregate tier totals: {'legacy_w26': 69, 'fine': 16, 'ultra': 12, 'nano': 9, 'atomic': 9, 'single_wei': 2}. Wave-26 legacy dust total was 62. Token-dust heuristic hits: 956. Finer detection does NOT adjudicate illicit dust evasion.
